mapper.select: SELECT M.MENU_ID, M.PARENT_MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_TYPE, M.MENU_PATH, M.SORT_NO, M.USE_YN, 'Y' AS QRY_ROL_YN, 'Y' AS REG_ROL_YN, 'Y' AS UPD_ROL_YN, 'Y' AS DEL_ROL_YN, 'Y' AS EXE_ROL_YN FROM (SELECT CAST('SMP000' AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS MENU_ID, CAST('0' AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS PARENT_MENU_ID, CAST('견본' AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS MENU_NM, CAST('G' AS CHAR(1)) AS MENU_TYPE, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(300)) AS MENU_PATH, 900 AS SORT_NO, CAST('Y' AS CHAR(1)) AS USE_YN FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'SMP001', 'SMP000', '공통 모듈', 'M', '/sample/common-modules', 1, 'Y' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'SMP002', 'SMP000', '공지사항', 'M', '/sample/notice', 2, 'Y' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'SMP003', 'SMP000', '기기정보', 'M', '/sample/mcn-info', 3, 'Y' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'SMP004', 'SMP000', '기기모델코드', 'M', '/sample/mcn-model', 4, 'Y' FROM DUAL ) M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.SORT_NO, M.MENU_ID
